title: Portable Node VM review of the RAM/parallel runner
execution_scope: Synthetic host only; no Windows, COM, WMI, Lean, Lake, C#, memory mapping, CI, or native commands.
inputs: The assembled package tools/native_runner.js must contain the exact frozen parallel and RAM source strings embedded in draft_sources.js.
output: A new JSON report containing source SHA256 bindings and 22 scoped synthetic-host results.
windows_launcher: The package run.cmd must not call Node or these tests; they are optional development evidence only.
host_adaptations: Seven assembled-runner COM environment setter expressions become __setEnv calls in the Node VM. Two are in the parallel draft, none in the RAM draft. The WSH entry point is not evaluated.
native_evidence: A PASS here means only that these simulated state-transition scenarios passed. It does not establish native compilation, Windows behavior, physical RAM bounds, residency, or speed.
previous_suites: Unrelated inherited cache/helper/lock suites were not rerun.
